scope: Real mobile TS/TSX through React renderer with synthetic APIs/native modules; no device or live provider execution.

failures: Insertion plus first-page polling drops former boundary ID 76.
Removed/inaccessible older ID 50 persists in the append-only cache.
initial_reproduction.source_scope: Initial three-case test file was not separately committed before additional regressions were added; named assertions and raw failure log are preserved.

environment.dependency_source: Existing slice-mobile app and tests node_modules reused through task-owned directory junctions; no install/download.

preserved_intermediate_outcomes.unsupported_case_expectation: Intermediate after-02 expected a retry button for unsupported native builds. Existing update-only UI was correct; corrected expectation retains all no-content assertions.
preserved_intermediate_outcomes.first_complete_run_cause: The new app-level dependency junction resolved React from app node_modules while react-test-renderer resolved the separate tests React installation, producing invalid-hook errors. Added the matching tests/node_modules junction; no package/source/behavior changes to bypass failures.

implementation.ordering: Strict descending immutable positive safe-integer ID; before_id upper bound with offset zero. Old servers ignoring the cursor fail visibly.
implementation.refresh: Rebuild the authoritative visible ID window from newest to the prior oldest ID, with at least 50 current rows, and replace atomically; Load older adds up to 50 rows below the prior floor.
implementation.bounds: 50 rows per request; existing 20-second shared polling deadline and per-request abort; cancellation checked before/after every page; no automatic offset fallback.
implementation.ownership: Distinct generation for settings/status/search, per-request sequence for supersession, current-owner guard for stale callbacks, cleanup/setup replay restoration.
implementation.privacy: 401/403 or unsupported from any page uses existing polling denial path to remove entire snapshot and suppress offline fallback; no older-row merge survives a successful refresh.
implementation.scroll: FlatList stable ID keys and maintainVisibleContentPosition with minIndexForVisible set to zero; actual native behavior unqualified.

limits: Synthetic React-renderer execution does not qualify installed Android/iOS scrolling, screen-reader focus, device keychain, native networking, or human UX acceptance.
Backend cursor tests and native PostgreSQL qualification are recorded separately by the backend worker/coordinator.
The running full Python suite is frozen at an earlier source and is not evidence for this late repair.
No production deployment, merge, provider credential/configuration change, or live provider call.
